text:
rachel.docs: Heads-up  I'm opening a tidy PR to unify function/tool-calling + structured-output examples. Goals: one canonical invoice schema, a minimal compact envelope for mobile, a tiny guardrails checklist, and two link fixes. Opening in ~45m.

omar.eng: Thanks. Can you list the snippets to touch? I can update node + python.

rachel.docs: Plan: 1) Move canonical schemas to /docs/schemas/invoice.v2.json; 2) Add a compact `schema_ref` envelope example; 3) Add a "consumer test" CI snippet (validator + graceful fallback); 4) Fix `/parsing/*` anchors that moved.

liz-devex: I'll convert SDK snippets to the new `structured_output` param. Minimal compact envelope example I want to add:
```json
{"tool_call":{"name":"fetch_invoice","arguments":{"id":"INV-777"}},"structured_output":{"schema_ref":"/docs/schemas/invoice.v2.json"}}
```

sam.qa: Please include a short CLI command for reviewers: `make docs-lint && ./tools/parse_validator --schema docs/schemas/invoice.v2.json --prompts examples/invoice_prompts.txt`. I'll run the harness and paste observed outputs.

omar.eng: FYI the runtime trims trailing zeros and collapses single-item arrays unless `minItems:1`. I'll post observed vs expected in the PR comments so examples match reality.

rachel.docs: Also adding a small guardrails box: "validate -> partial-parse (keep present fields) -> fallback to raw text". And a gotchas bullet about `oneOf` ambiguity and nullable arrays.

liz-devex: I'll include a compact mobile example and a full-envelope example so readers see both patterns. Also tagging canonical examples with `example:canonical-v2` so we can track them in evals.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5122 by rachel.docs

rachel.docs: Assigning reviewers @liz-devex and @omar.eng. Target merge by Thu EOD if CI/lint pass. I'll push the first commit in 30m and ping here when it's up.
